what: Each time the share of the step list passing from 80% to 45% of the screen exceeds i/step count, the i-th step name lights in the accent color (.6s), and the side mark piece (like a four-part quarter-circle logo) also snaps into shape in data-key order from .1 · .82x (.6s fade-in · .9s expo.out grow). Scrolling back turns them off again. If the piece sits apart above the list, as on phone, the piece is lit separately by the share of its own position passing 85%→35%

options.start · end: Step progress range (relative to the step list), default top 80% · bottom 45%
options.tile-start · tile-end: Piece progress range while pieces are apart, default ‹top 85%› and ‹bottom 35%›
options.apart: Screen width at which the pieces are treated as apart (media query), default “(max-width: 63.99rem)”
options.[data-fx-part=step]: Steps (children) — inside it [data-fx-part=name] lights up in the accent color
options.[data-fx-part=tile]: (optional) Display pieces — data-key is the turn it lights up (from 0), without it the placed order

use:
1. One

    2. …
note: The piece shape (quadrant · color) is painted by the caller. To light them clockwise in a 2×2 grid, set data-key to 0·1·3·2

from.where: index.js progress(), the original [data-progress]: the [data-step] list toggles is-on in onUpdate from top 80% → bottom 45%, [data-step-tile] in the order 0·1·3·2 (clockwise), and below 64rem the piece group runs separately from top 85% → bottom 35%. .flow-tile opacity .6s · transform .9s expo, turned-off ones go to .1 · scale .82
